verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a split-inbox or focused-streams feature that separates important, team, newsletter and calendar-invite mail for priority-ordered triage. The only related items are the bare titles of the 'Filters & Rules' and 'Achieve inbox zero' pages, plus a community mention of a custom filter view. Those are adjacent rule and search tools a user would configure by hand, not the stream-splitting capability itself.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can split my inbox into focused streams — important, team, newsletters, calendar invites — so triage happens in priority order, not arrival order
